row.title: Q-GAP: a done check that a file's existence can satisfy is tightened when the file alone does not prove the item
row.body: Q-GAP-executor-merged-pr now closes on a pr-merged row (opened is not merged) and Q-GAP-multi-tenant-controls on tenantcontrols --ready (every control proven, 2 of 5 on 2026-11-20). Five gap items that need an outside party, a new account, another cloud or a pilot are gates in doctrine/open-loops.json with their surfaces and defaults; their proof files are written only by the real event.
